RJ-001.summary: Your name in PF records doesn't match your Aadhaar. This is the most common rejection reason.

steps.title: Check your UAN portal
steps.description: Login to https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in and go to 'Manage' → 'KYC' to see your current name on record.

steps.title: Identify the mismatch
steps.description: Compare your name in PF records with your Aadhaar card. Common issues: spelling differences, middle name missing, initials vs full name.

steps.title: Request name correction
steps.description: Submit a joint declaration (Form-1) with your employer to correct the name. Your employer needs to approve this on the employer portal.

steps.title: Wait for update
steps.description: Name corrections typically take 7-15 working days. You'll get an SMS confirmation.

steps.title: Resubmit your claim
steps.description: Once your name is corrected, submit a fresh claim through the UAN portal.

RJ-002.summary: Your date of birth in PF records doesn't match your Aadhaar/PAN. This needs employer cooperation to fix.

steps.title: Verify DOB on UAN portal
steps.description: Login and check your date of birth under 'View' → 'Profile'.

steps.title: Contact your employer's HR
steps.description: Ask HR to submit a DOB correction through the employer portal with supporting documents (Aadhaar/PAN copy).

steps.title: Submit supporting documents
steps.description: Provide a self-attested copy of Aadhaar and PAN to your employer for verification.

steps.title: Wait for EPFO approval
steps.description: DOB corrections are processed by the EPFO regional office. This may take 15-30 days.

steps.title: Resubmit claim
steps.description: After correction is reflected, submit a new claim.

RJ-003.summary: Father's name mismatch between PF records and KYC documents.

steps.title: Check records
steps.description: Verify father's name on UAN portal under your profile.

steps.title: Request correction via employer
steps.description: Submit a joint declaration with employer to correct father's name.

steps.title: Provide documents
steps.description: Submit Aadhaar/PAN/10th marksheet showing correct father's name.

steps.title: Resubmit after correction
steps.description: Once updated, file your claim again.

RJ-004.summary: Your bank account couldn't be verified, or the name on the bank account doesn't match your PF records.

steps.title: Check linked bank account
steps.description: Login to UAN portal → 'Manage' → 'KYC' and verify your bank account number and IFSC.

steps.title: Ensure name matches
steps.description: The name on your bank account must exactly match the name in your PF records. Check your bank passbook.

steps.title: Upload cancelled cheque
steps.description: If needed, upload a cancelled cheque or passbook front page on the UAN portal.

steps.title: Verify bank details
steps.description: Click 'Verify' next to your bank account on the KYC page. Verification is usually instant via penny-drop.

steps.title: Resubmit claim
steps.description: Once bank is verified (green tick), submit your claim again.

RJ-005.summary: Your Aadhaar is not linked (seeded) to your UAN. This is mandatory for all online claims.

steps.title: Go to KYC section
steps.description: Login to UAN portal → 'Manage' → 'KYC'.

steps.title: Add Aadhaar
steps.description: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number and name as per Aadhaar.

steps.title: Employer approval
steps.description: Your employer needs to approve the Aadhaar seeding on their portal.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: UIDAI verification happens automatically. Wait for green 'Verified' status.

steps.title: Resubmit claim
steps.description: Once Aadhaar shows as verified, submit your claim.

RJ-006.summary: PAN card is not linked or details don't match with EPFO records.

steps.title: Add PAN on UAN portal
steps.description: Go to 'Manage' → 'KYC' and add your PAN number.

steps.title: Get employer approval
steps.description: Employer must approve the PAN addition.

steps.title: Wait for verification
steps.description: PAN verification with Income Tax department takes 2-5 days.

steps.title: Resubmit
steps.description: After PAN shows verified, resubmit your claim.

RJ-007.summary: Your employer hasn't approved your claim yet. Many employers delay attestation, especially after you leave the company.

steps.title: Contact HR directly
steps.description: Call or email your former employer's HR department and request them to attest your claim on the EPFO employer portal.

steps.title: Send a formal reminder
steps.description: If they don't respond, send an email with your UAN, Member ID, and claim reference number requesting attestation.

steps.title: File grievance on EPFiGMS
steps.description: If employer still doesn't respond after 7 days, file a complaint at https://epfigms.gov.in against the employer.

steps.title: Contact EPFO office
steps.description: Visit or call your regional EPFO office. They can send a notice to the employer.

steps.title: Alternative: Transfer to new employer
steps.description: If you've joined a new company, transfer your PF and your new employer can attest the claim.

RJ-008.summary: You haven't completed the required service period. Full PF withdrawal needs 60 days of unemployment after leaving.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.description: For Form 19 (full withdrawal): You must be unemployed for at least 2 months. For Form 31 (advance): Check specific advance rules.

steps.title: Wait if needed
steps.description: If you recently left your job, wait for the required period to complete.

steps.title: Consider partial withdrawal
steps.description: If you need funds urgently, check if you're eligible for a partial advance (Form 31) which has different rules.

steps.title: Resubmit after eligibility
steps.description: Submit your claim after completing the required service/unemployment period.

RJ-014.summary: You requested more money than allowed for this type of advance. Each advance type has a maximum limit.

steps.title: Check advance limits
steps.description: Housing: Up to 36 months' basic wages or total PF balance (whichever is less). Medical: Up to 6 months' wages. Education: Up to 50% of employee share.

steps.title: Calculate your eligible amount
steps.description: Check your PF passbook on the UAN portal to see your current balance and calculate the maximum allowed.

steps.title: Resubmit with correct amount
steps.description: File a new claim with an amount within the permissible limit.

RJ-020.summary: The IFSC code of your bank branch is wrong or the branch has been merged/renamed.

steps.title: Check current IFSC
steps.description: Ask your bank for the current IFSC code. Many branches were merged due to bank consolidation (e.g., SBI, PNB mergers).

steps.title: Update on UAN portal
steps.description: Go to 'Manage' → 'KYC', update your bank account with the correct IFSC code.

steps.title: Verify again
steps.description: Wait for the bank account to show 'Verified' status.

steps.title: Resubmit
steps.description: Submit your claim with the corrected bank details.

RJ-025.summary: Your digital signature couldn't be verified. This usually happens with Aadhaar-based e-sign issues.

steps.title: Check Aadhaar mobile link
steps.description: Ensure your mobile number is registered with Aadhaar for OTP-based e-signing.

steps.title: Clear browser cache
steps.description: Clear cookies and cache, use Chrome/Edge, and try the claim submission again.

steps.title: Try again during off-peak
steps.description: EPFO servers are less busy early morning (6-9 AM) or late night. Try submitting during these hours.

steps.title: Use Aadhaar OTP method
steps.description: If using digital certificate, switch to Aadhaar OTP method for signing.
